description: This file defines functions and types for constructing detailed system prompts for an AI agent within the OpenClaw framework. It includes logic for including various sections such as tooling, workspace, runtime info, safety, and context files, as well as handling sandboxing, approvals, and agent configuration.

methods.name: buildSkillsSection
methods.description: Constructs the skills section of the system prompt based on provided skills prompt and read tool name.

methods.name: buildMemorySection
methods.description: Builds the memory-related section of the prompt unless in minimal mode.

methods.name: buildUserIdentitySection
methods.description: Creates the section listing authorized senders if applicable.

methods.name: formatOwnerDisplayId
methods.description: Generates a hashed or raw owner ID for display.

methods.name: buildOwnerIdentityLine
methods.description: Constructs the line listing allowlisted senders.

methods.name: buildTimeSection
methods.description: Creates a section with current timezone info if provided.

methods.name: buildReplyTagsSection
methods.description: Builds the reply tags guidance section unless in minimal mode.

methods.name: buildMessagingSection
methods.description: Constructs messaging-related instructions based on available tools and configuration.

methods.name: buildVoiceSection
methods.description: Creates the TTS (voice) section if a hint is provided.

methods.name: buildDocsSection
methods.description: Builds documentation links section unless in minimal mode.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalPromptGuidance
methods.description: Provides guidance on handling approval-pending states based on runtime channel capabilities.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Main function that assembles the full system prompt string based on various parameters, including tools, context, sandbox, approvals, and more.

methods.name: buildRuntimeLine
methods.description: Generates a string describing the current runtime environment and capabilities.
